skill_name: Critically analyse the six core principles of design-thinking
workflow: Design thinking is a human-centered approach to problem-solving that encourages creativity and innovation. The core principles of design thinking involve understanding the user and the context, following a creative and iterative process, embracing exploration and collaboration, employing prototyping and testing, and communicating effectively. By understanding the needs and experiences of users, designers can develop creative solutions that would not have been possible with a traditional approach
